summary: The evening goes on as usual after a public event: supper, music, a play, friends.
realLife: On May 29, 1660 Pepys supped and listened to music after his day; when Parliament voted the King the excise he went to a play that evening.
sources: Diary of Samuel Pepys, May 1660, Wikisource: https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Diary_of_Samuel_Pepys/1660/May
Diary of Samuel Pepys, November 1660, Wikisource: https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Diary_of_Samuel_Pepys/1660/November
inGame: The `watched` and `ahead` moves together: the day's ordinary parts around the address.
